about:
Farley's Imports Car Care, Inc. operates as Farley's American & Foreign Auto Repair in Casper, Wyoming. The business was established in 2006 and serves the local market from its single location. Ownership details and founder names are not publicly disclosed.

The shop provides bumper-to-bumper automotive repair and maintenance for both foreign and domestic vehicles, excluding paint and body work. Services are performed by ASE-certified technicians who collectively bring more than 20 years of experience. The facility operates as a certified NAPA AutoCare Center, the only one in the Casper area, and backs repairs with a six-month or 6,000-mile warranty. Headcount, facility size, and annual service volume are not published.

The customer base consists primarily of individual vehicle owners in central Wyoming needing routine maintenance, diagnostics, tire service, and mechanical repairs. The shop does not target fleet or commercial accounts specifically, though it services all makes and models.

The company distinguishes itself through its NAPA AutoCare certification, the experience of its technician team, and the warranty coverage offered on all repairs. The decision to focus on mechanical work while referring out paint and body jobs reflects a specialization strategy.
